About Us
We are a global community headquartered in Northern Israel focused on one unified goal – to pioneer solutions that expand what’s possible in neurovascular therapy.

What we do

Utilizing proprietary manufacturing techniques, we develop the only responsive, remotely adjustable interventional tools to treat ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke.

Leadership Team

Our leadership team combines several decades of global MedTech experience to advance neurovascular technologies, for optimized stroke procedures and better patient outcomes.

  • RONEN ECKHOUSE
    CO-FOUNDER & CEO
    Read bio
    CO-FOUNDER AND CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD

    Ronen Eckhouse is the co-founder and CEO of Rapid Medical. He brings more than 20 years of experience in leadership, management and operations, including serving as a Major in the elite Shayetet 13, equivalent to the U.S. Navy Seals. Ronen holds a BSc in Electrical Engineering from the Technion Institute of Technology, and an MBA from the Haas School of Business at UC Berkeley.

  • MICHAL SHRIKI
    CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
    Read bio

    Michal Shriki joined Rapid Medical in 2018 and brings over a decade of professional experience serving as CFO and COO for several international high-tech companies, such as Galil Medical Ltd (acquired by BTG) and Starling Advanced Communications Ltd (acquired by Panasonic). Michal is a Certified Accountant with a BA in Economics and an MBA from the University of Haifa, Israel.

  • DR. WALID HADDAD
    CHIEF CLINICAL OFFICER
    Read bio

    Dr. Walid Haddad joined Rapid Medical in 2017 as the Chief Clinical Officer. He brings over 15 years of experience in clinical research, strategy, medical affairs, and operations as a C-suite executive in the biomedical industry. Additionally, Dr. Haddad carries extensive experience in executing FDA regulated studies. Most recently, he served as Chief Operations Officer for a cardiology startup, CardioGard. Dr. Haddad holds a Ph.D. in Physiology from the Faculty of Medicine from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.

  • EITAN HAVIS
    PRESIDENT, INTERNATIONAL
    Read bio

    Eitan Havis joined Rapid Medical in 2013 as the 7th employee. Now serving as the President, International, Eitan spearheads sales and marketing activities in Europe, Asia and the Middle East. He has over 20 years of commercial leadership experience and helped to grow Rapid Medical from an early-stage start-up to a well-funded commercial operation. Eitan holds a BA in Business Administration and Economics from Haifa University in Israel.

  • JAMES ROMERO
    PRESIDENT, AMERICAS
    Read bio

    James Romero joined Rapid Medical in 2021 as an accomplished medical device executive responsible for the US, Canadian and Latin American businesses. He previously served as Vice President of Sales and led Sales Operations and Global Sales Training for the neurovascular division at Medtronic. James brings over 20 years of leadership experience in growth-stage and large-scale MedTech companies and holds a BS in Psychology from Santa Clara University.

  • GIORA KORNBLAU
    CHIEF TECHNOLOGY OFFICER
    Read bio

    Giora Kornblau carries more than 20 years of leadership experience, including 12 years as an entrepreneur and founder of market-leading MedTech start-ups, such as Navotek and Calore Medical. Prior to joining Rapid Medical, he was a partner at Terra VP leading Israeli VC and managed a technology incubator, where he helped develop deep technology products in the fields of clean energy and health. Mr. Kornblau graduated from the prestigious Talpiot program, served as an F-16 pilot in the Israeli Air Force, and holds a Bachelor’s degree with Honors in Physics and Mathematics from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.

A patient-centric approach to AIS

TIGERTRIEVER™ is the only active thrombectomy device – it is engineered to adapt to patient anatomy. Accelerate clot integration and reduce stress on the brain during mechanical thrombectomy procedures.

Request a demo

Gain activecontrol

Unlike conventional stent retrievers, active thrombectomy can improve clot penetration¹ and facilitate smooth retrieval with adjustable radial force.

Acceleratethrombectomy

Two million brain cells die every minute. TIGERTRIEVER™ saves minutes when removing the clot – with reported procedure times faster than the leading competitors.

Speed matters – TIGER Trial showed quicker time to reperfusion than using aspiration alone.

The 1st passshould be the last

Adjustability handles patient variability in real-time. TIGERTRIEVER™ has high first-pass success (FPE) and low emboli to new territory (ENT), outperforming competitors in challenging procedures involving stenosis, hard clot, and tortuosity in patients with intracranial atherosclerosis (ICAD).

Product overview

The world's first and only adjustable stent retriever, TIGERTRIEVER™ is designed with active, responsive technology for patient-specific procedures.

  • Reinforced distal protection

    Distal Embolic Net (“TIGER DEN”) helps protect against distal emboli and provides the lowest ENT rate of any mechanical thrombectomy trial (2.6%).¹

  • Complete visibility

    Radiopacity improves first-pass success with precise positioning & visual feedback.⁶˒⁷˒⁸

  • Proprietary active technology

    The only clot retriever equipped with real-time adjustability – accelerates clot integration and removes tension on the vessel.

  • Small microcatheter compatibility

    Lower profile microcatheter (MC) compatibility and lower delivery forces.

Bridging the gap in assist devices

COMANECI™ is the only non-occlusive and temporary device for wide-neck aneurysm treatment.

Request a demo

Minimize the risk and disruption to patients' lives with lasting results. COMANECI™ is the first active assist device – its added user control overcomes the limitations of conventional balloons and stents.

Stability doesn'trequire implants

The temporary deployment of COMANECI™ provides the long-term support of a stent, achieving high packing density and 85% immediate complete occlusion compared to 79% with stent-assisted coiling.¹

Avoiding implants like stents is preferable to allow the brain to heal naturally and minimize long-term stroke risks and bleeding complications.

Continuousblood supply

Unlike balloons, COMANECI™ provides support without blocking blood flow to the brain. Clinicians can focus on accurate placement rather than the countdown to an ischemic event. COMANECI™ demonstrates the highest complete occlusion and lowest complication rates.

See the comparison

Leaves no trace —except SUCCESS

95% successful long-term occlusion and 1% retreatment rates show the lasting durability of treatment with COMANECI in both ruptured and unruptured wide-neck aneurysms.²

Product overview

COMANECI™ is designed with active, responsive technology to enable non-occlusive coil embolization procedures.

  • Non-occlusive design

    Unique braiding technology prevents flow disruption during the coiling procedure.

  • Complete visibility

    100% radiopacity enables precise positioning & visualization throughout the procedure.

  • Proprietary active technology

    Operator-controlled adjustability enables adjustable vessel conformity.

  • Low profile delivery

    >25% smaller than the smallest occlusion balloons³ facilitates access to complex anatomy and enhances stability.
